scope: EXACT IMPLEMENTATION ONLY — signal_validity.py v1 (real-DNCA precondition #3 probe). NOT a kill of DOPA-CLOSURE; the theory remains UNTESTED.
killed_claim: DNCA mismatch/dopamine_signal is non-trivially truth-correlated with prediction-violation (instrument self-reported SIGNAL_ADMISSIBLE, mismatch AUC=1.000, p=0.0021).
reason: Confounded task by construction. The SHOCK regime injects N(0, SHOCK_GAIN=4.0) vs unit-scale AR(1); the shock is therefore detectable by raw input magnitude alone. Adversarial control: AUC(raw_input_norm) = 0.992/0.981/0.982 and AUC(raw_input_var) ~ identical across seeds 1/2/3 — essentially the same ceiling as DNCA mismatch AUC=1.000. The perfect AUC carries no DNCA-specific information; it is an artifact of the task generator, not evidence the dopaminergic signal is non-trivially informative.
decision_rule_applied: TASK 5: DNCA signal does not exceed a trivial baseline -> INADMISSIBLE, neither KILLED nor SURVIVED. The instrument's own SIGNAL_ADMISSIBLE verdict is overridden: it lacked the mandatory trivial-baseline negative control (a repeat of the GAP_AUDIT construct-validity defect class).
minimal_counterexample: raw_input_norm AUC ~= 0.99 ~= DNCA_mismatch AUC 1.00 on all 3 seeds; no separation attributable to DNCA.
sapolsky_vector_breach: SV7 (confident clean number from an uncontrolled instrument) and SV6 (perfect AUC treated as signal without trivial-baseline gate).
required_redesign_v2_preregistered: Variance-matched shock: violate AR(1) temporal structure while preserving marginal scale (e.g. phase-scrambled or sign-permuted dynamics at identical variance) so raw magnitude cannot separate.

Mandatory trivial-baseline negative control (raw input norm/var) computed every run; verdict ADMISSIBLE requires DNCA AUC to exceed trivial-baseline AUC by >= TRIVIAL_MARGIN with non-overlapping null.
Compute feasibility: ~30+ min for 1800 DNCA steps on CPU is itself a finding — v2 must bound runtime or justify scale.
Re-pre-register before running; no verdict from v1.
